newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Two S.Korean firms to seek 21,500T of U.S. wheat.
newsitem.headline: Two S.Korean firms to seek 21,500T of U.S. wheat.

text.p: South Korea's Cheiljedang Corp and Dongah Flour Mills Co Ltd have jointly invited tenders to buy 21,500 tonnes of U.S. No.1 wheat by 2:00 p.m. (0500 GMT) on Thursday, traders said on Wednesday.
Of the total, Cheiljedang would buy 11,000 tonnes at basis prices over December futures on the U.S. grain futures exchanges including the Chicago Board of Trade, they said.
Dongah Flour would seek the remaining 10,500 tonnes at fixed prices.
Shipment was set for September 5-October 5 to the southeastern port of Pusan.
